    Main
    Do NOT add any static variables to this class, or any initialization at all.
    MatchSummary
    A short summary of the run, kept as it happens: battery, brownouts, loop overruns, CAN drops and reboots, Driver Station drops, vision counts, how auto went, alerts raised and peak motor temperatures.
    Mechanism
    Abstract base class representing a CTRE TalonFX-driven robot mechanism with common control modes, telemetry, and convenience Command factories.
    Mechanism.Config
    Configuration for a Mechanism, encapsulating the TalonFX hardware configuration, control request objects, and mechanism-level parameters (gear ratio, soft limits, PID/FF gains, Motion Magic profile, current limits, etc.).
    Mechanism.FollowerConfig
    Configuration for a TalonFX follower motor that mirrors the leader.
    ModifierChords
    Buttons shared between bare bindings and modifier chords (LB + A, RT + X, ...), resolved as one answer from the buttons held.
    MotorInputs
    Everything a Mechanism reads from its motors in one loop, as an AdvantageKit input.
    MotorResetMonitor
    Tracks whether a motor has rebooted since its position was last set, so a homed mechanism stops trusting a position that restarted from the boot value.
    Mount
    Represents a simulation component that other mechanisms can be attached to.
    Mount.MountType
    Discriminates between the two supported mount types so child mechanisms can apply the correct positioning logic.
    Mountable
    Mixin interface for simulation components that can be attached to a Mount.
    Network
    Common Network Utilities

    Publishes params at <prefix>/<group>/<key> on NetworkTables through AdvantageKit's LoggedNetwork inputs, so the dashboard's requests are in the log too.

    SimLoop
    Shared high-frequency simulation loop.
    SimMotor
    Shared wiring between a TalonFX and the WPILib physics sims in this package.
    SimScript
    A scripted drive for the desktop simulation, so the localization testbed can be exercised (and checked) without a driver: sit disabled so the Limelights seed the pose, then drive a lap of straights, strafes and spins in teleop while every pose source is logged.
    SimScript.Actions
    The script's two non-driver actions, as an AdvantageKit input so a replay of a scripted run performs them on the same loop (the driving itself is already replayed, through the logged Driver Station).

    Simulated cameras for every pose source, on PhotonLib's VisionSystemSim.

    SystemLoadMonitor
    Watches the things that made the robot fall behind on 2026-09-05 and says so on the dashboard.
    TagEkf
    An extended Kalman filter over (x, y, heading) that takes every camera's tags one at a time, in the style of 971's AOS localizer: each tag is a bearing and a distance from its camera, so a single or far tag still corrects the pose at a low weight instead of being thrown away, and every camera feeds the same estimate.
    TagEkf.CameraStats
    Per-camera tag counts, and this loop's residuals of the tags that passed.
    TagField
    Which AprilTag field the robot solves with, as a logged input (Vision/FieldMap/Name and Hash).
    TagField.Choice
    The field vision solves with.
    TagSighting
    One AprilTag seen by one camera in one frame: where the tag's centre was, relative to the camera.
    TalonFXFactory
    Creates CANTalon objects and configures all the parameters we care about to factory defaults.
    Telemetry
    Telemetry and logging facade, backed by AdvantageKit.
    Telemetry.Fault
    Named fault conditions that can be surfaced as structured log entries.
    Telemetry.PrintPriority
    Priority levels for printing to the console.
    TiltState
    What the Pigeon says about the robot's attitude and knocks, derived from logged inputs so it replays.
    TrackingStop
    Latches a mechanism to a stop once it has stayed out of tolerance of its closed-loop goal for a debounce time: a jam, a slipped belt, a motor fighting a hard stop.
    Trio<A,B,C>
    Represents a trio of three objects.
    TuneValue
    A number that can be changed from a dashboard at runtime without redeploying, for tuning gains, speeds and other constants.
    TuningMode
    Whether dashboards may change tunable values.

    Basic helpers imported from the 254 lib (1678-2024).
